subject: Co-sell enablement & SKU mapping for CloudBridge listing
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudbridge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Sharma <r.sharma@cloudsellers.io>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Listing & co-sell: CloudBridge + Redwood — SKU mapping and enablement

Hi Sofia,

Great chatting yesterday. CloudBridge is ready to move forward with public listings on GCP and Azure and we'd like Redwood to be the reference co-sell partner on both marketplaces. To get to the marketplace onboarding and co-sell enablement we need two things from your side: a SKU mapping doc that aligns your published SKUs/pricing to our bundle SKUs, and a short seller-facing package (one-pager + any cert/evidence) we can pass to the cloud partner managers.

I've attached our Seller Guide for reference (CloudBridge_SellerGuide.pdf). Can your alliances team:
- confirm the SKU taxonomy you want to expose on each cloud (metering vs. subscription)
- provide an initial mapping spreadsheet (example attached would be great)
- confirm co-sell entitlements (sales credits/discounts, lead routing)

AWS PM asked to be looped once we have the SKU map; Rajiv (cc) is our commercial lead and will coordinate contract steps. We aim to hit initial marketplace publish window in the next 3 weeks.

Would love a quick sync — 30 mins — early next week if that works.

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Solutions
amy@cloudbridge.com
Attachment: CloudBridge_SellerGuide.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: CloudBridge + Redwood — SKU mapping and enablement

Hi Amy — thanks for the doc and the clear ask. Happy to run point on this from Redwood.

Quick notes up front:
- We'll align on SKU taxonomy (metering vs. subscription) and then produce the SKU_Mapping_CloudBridge.xlsx draft.
- Vanessa will own the marketplace listing steps (Azure/GCP) and Laura will handle partner commercial entitlements. Ben will work on the technical listing requirements and certs.

Can you confirm two things before we kick off the mapping:
1) Which billing model do you prefer for GCP (metered usage or committed subscription)?
2) Do you have a preferred public pricing band or should we mirror your current public pricing?

I've attached our Redwood_GTM-Checklist.docx — it lists the docs cloud marketplaces typically ask for and the usual QA gates. I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Monday (I'll send a calendar invite after I hear from you).

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_GTM-Checklist.docx (DOCX, 340 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Amy Chen <amy@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: CloudBridge + Redwood — SKU mapping and enablement

On Wed, May 9, 2028 at 12:05 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've attached our Redwood_GTM-Checklist.docx — it lists the docs cloud marketplaces typically ask for and the usual QA gates.

Thanks — looping in some initial tech notes so we don't hit surprises during listing QA:
- For both GCP and Azure we need a containerized deployment artifact (we provide a small connector image) OR a marketplace-friendly manifest. If CloudBridge prefers metered SKUs, we need clear usage dimensions (token-based, instance-hours, seats).
- Please add column in SKU mapping for "metering dimension" and "recommended default tier".
- For certs: SOC 2 type II and data residency docs live in our shared drive; if you can point to equivalent items in your seller guide we'll attach them to the listing.

I've attached the starter SKU mapping template (SKU_Mapping_CloudBridge.xlsx). I populated two example rows: a co-sell bundle (CB-Redwood-Core) and an add-on (CB-KV-Caching). Review and fill pricing bands and metering fields.

Next steps: Amy/CloudBridge fills the sheet; Vanessa and I will triage listing schedule and queue the cloud PMs once mapping is stable.

–Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: SKU_Mapping_CloudBridge.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)

From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, AWS Partner Manager <pm-aws@amazon.com>, Rajiv Sharma <r.sharma@cloudsellers.io>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 19:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: CloudBridge + Redwood — SKU mapping and enablement

Thanks Ben — sheet filled and returned (see attached). I've included our preferred billing model: GCP will be metered (token-based) for the platform bundle; Azure we'll start with subscription tiers. Pricing columns completed, and I've added our legal contact for contract templating.

Forwarding AWS PM per your ask — PM mentioned they prefer to see SKU mapping and seller guide before locking co-sell entitlements. Also, here's the DocuSign template for co-sell agreement to speed contracting: https://www.docusign.com/templates/sg-cloudbridge-co-sell

Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: CloudBridge + Redwood — SKU mapping and enablement

Perfect — appreciate the fast turnaround, Amy. Summary and next actions to keep momentum:

1) CloudBridge to finalize SKU_Mapping_CloudBridge.xlsx (done) — Ben to validate metering columns and confirm manifest artifacts (by Tue 5/14).
2) Vanessa to open listing tickets with GCP and Azure marketplace teams and provide expected publish windows (Vanessa will share scheduling by EOD Monday).
3) Laura + Rajiv to confirm co-sell entitlements and sales credit percentages; draft DocuSign template in parallel (Laura to own).
4) Vivek to check pricing bands against Redwood published SKUs for billing alignment and exceptions (Vivek to confirm by 5/16).
5) Sofia to run weekly sync through go-to-market until publish; next call is Monday 5/13 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite sent.

HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/CB-4872

If anything changes on the legal side please loop Laura and Rajiv. Looking forward to getting this live.

Thanks,
